name: AST Lens
description: The agent reads code as code: structural search and rewrite with ast-grep, and go-to-definition, references, rename, hover, symbols and diagnostics from the language server picked by the file extension, and a debugger that shows the stack and values at a breakpoint, instead of grepping text.
author: eskwisit

en.name: AST Lens
en.description: The agent reads code as code: structural search and rewrite with ast-grep, and go-to-definition, references, rename, hover, symbols and diagnostics from the language server picked by the file extension, and a debugger that shows the stack and values at a breakpoint, instead of grepping text.
en.safetyNotes: agent.extension loads one agent module. It adds three tools (ast_grep only when ast-grep is installed) and a /ast-lens command. The ast_grep tool runs the ast-grep you installed (ast-grep, or sg) in the project folder; it only changes files when the agent passes apply: true with a rewrite. The lsp tool starts the language server installed for the file's extension (for example typescript-language-server, TypeScript 7's tsc --lsp, pyright, gopls, rust-analyzer, clangd), from your PATH, the usual install folders or the project's node_modules/.bin; the server runs in the project folder, reads the project, and is stopped after 10 idle minutes or when the session ends. To answer definitions and outlines without a language server, it runs ast-grep outline on the project and keeps the result in memory. The debug tool runs the program the agent names, with the arguments it gives: Node.js programs under Node's own inspector on 127.0.0.1, and Python, Go and native programs under the debug adapter installed on your machine (debugpy, dlv, lldb-dap); eval runs expressions inside that program. It stops the program after a probe, at the end of a session, and when the session ends. The plugin downloads and installs nothing and makes no network requests itself. Before each turn it adds a short AST Lens section to the system prompt. After a Grep call that searches code for an identifier, it rewrites the result: grouped by file and, when ast-grep is installed, with hits in comments and strings shown as line numbers (it runs ast-grep on the files of the hits for that); for TypeScript and C/C++ it may add a one-line hint (mode steer). It never blocks Grep. Mode off leaves Grep results and the system prompt alone. After Edit, Write and Bash calls it tells the running language servers which files changed. With maxRssMb set (macOS, Linux), it reads the servers' memory with ps and stops a server above that limit. /ast-lens mode writes the mode to ast-lens/config.json in ~/.config (macOS, Linux) or %APPDATA% (Windows); that file may also set maxRssMb and map file extensions to your own language server commands. To find tools when PI-Desktop was started from the Dock or a desktop launcher, it reads your login shell's PATH once on macOS and Linux. On Windows it runs npm .cmd shims' programs directly, and other .bat launchers through cmd.exe with escaped arguments. Stopping a server also stops its child processes. agent.prompt.inject makes the AST Lens skill available to the Skill tool.

zh-CN.name: AST Lens
zh-CN.description: 让智能体把代码当作代码来读：用 ast-grep 做结构化搜索与改写，并按文件扩展名选择语言服务器，提供跳转定义、查找引用、重命名、悬停信息、符号与诊断，并提供能在断点处显示调用栈和变量值的调试器，而不是用 grep 搜索文本。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: agent.extension 加载一个智能体模块，添加三个工具（仅在已安装 ast-grep 时添加 ast_grep）和一个 /ast-lens 命令。ast_grep 工具在项目文件夹中运行你已安装的 ast-grep（ast-grep 或 sg）；只有当智能体以 apply: true 配合 rewrite 调用时才会修改文件。lsp 工具启动与文件扩展名对应、已安装的语言服务器（例如 typescript-language-server、TypeScript 7 的 tsc --lsp、pyright、gopls、rust-analyzer、clangd），从你的 PATH、常见安装目录或项目的 node_modules/.bin 中查找；服务器在项目文件夹中运行并读取项目，空闲 10 分钟或会话结束时停止，停止时也会结束其子进程。为了不经语言服务器即可回答定义和大纲，它会对项目运行 ast-grep outline，并把结果保存在内存中。debug 工具运行智能体指定的程序及其参数：Node.js 程序在 Node 自带的调试器（127.0.0.1）下运行，Python、Go 和原生程序在你机器上已安装的调试适配器（debugpy、dlv、lldb-dap）下运行；eval 会在该程序内执行表达式。探测结束、会话结束或整个会话结束时，它会停止该程序。插件不下载、不安装任何内容，自身不发起网络请求。每轮对话前，它会在系统提示中加入一小段 AST Lens 说明。当 Grep 调用在代码中搜索标识符时，它会改写结果：按文件分组；若已安装 ast-grep，注释和字符串中的命中只显示行号（为此它会对命中所在的文件运行 ast-grep）；对 TypeScript 和 C/C++ 还可能附加一行提示（steer 模式）。它从不阻止 Grep。off 模式下不改动 Grep 结果和系统提示。在 Edit、Write 和 Bash 调用之后，它会告诉正在运行的语言服务器哪些文件已更改。设置 maxRssMb 后（macOS、Linux），它用 ps 读取服务器的内存，并停止超过该上限的服务器。/ast-lens mode 会把模式写入 ~/.config（macOS、Linux）或 %APPDATA%（Windows）下的 ast-lens/config.json；该文件还可以设置 maxRssMb，并把文件扩展名映射到你自己的语言服务器命令。为了在从程序坞或桌面启动器打开 PI-Desktop 时也能找到工具，它会在 macOS 和 Linux 上读取一次登录 shell 的 PATH。在 Windows 上，它直接运行 npm .cmd 包装脚本所指向的程序，其他 .bat 启动器则经由 cmd.exe 并对参数转义后运行。agent.prompt.inject 用于为 Skill 工具索引 AST Lens 技能。
